segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: The reason I ask this, Mr. Chair, is that if we don't consider that, we might have to disagree completely with the House.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: Because if not, so usually for expediency, pagka hindi siya ganung controversial, sige kahit pareho, balikan natin sa bay kami yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: E ngayon, kung sasabihin natin na susundin natin even without an appeal, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: So I know there are probably six or seven, eight parts of the decision.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: Hindi ko hihimayin isang ngayon because we want to get started.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: But personally, I disagree that the BICAM should be disarmed.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: Remember, we come back here to concur.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: And remember, the BICAM is now open.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: There's still many things to do there, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: But that's an example, Mr. Chair, that I meant, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: I will have much less questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: If ang sasabihin natin, no, no, no, the BICAM can still decide this.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: Pero kung sasabihin natin, hindi, basta pareho tayo ng House, hindi ko na mababalikan yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: I have to do that in the next four or five days.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We can actually go into that later on when we discuss the general principles.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: On the few topics that are minority-led.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I thank him for the support for the budget.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: The secretaries are here with us.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I know that our senators have their own way of analyzing, extracting data.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Kahit kami, humihingi kami data diretso sa opisina ng mga sekretaris kung meron kaming nakikitang gustong pag-aralan.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So we beg the indulgence of the secretaries to furnish.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We'll furnish the senators with the data that they need in order to expedite the analysis.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Importante ho talaga yan dahil para bumilis po yung discussion natin on the budget.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: With that, again, I thank the minority leader for his support.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And as we go along, we will furnish the minority leader with the documents that he needs

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: and the documents that the minority group also needs.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, if I may, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Also, it would be also easier for us, more expedient for us,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: if the secretaries that will be called in the next few days

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: could also visit the minority leader and the members of the minority.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Maybe there are certain discussions that no longer need to be asked on the floor

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: that would be able to hasten proceedings on the floor, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In fact, that is the style of Senator Pia Cayetano.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung mga items na hindi clear.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I think that's a good way of expediting the budget process.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And the other secretaries will let them know that it is a good way of expediting the budget

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: by directly explaining to the Senators.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Secretary Goh po, hindi po bongo.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Secretary, kung meron silang Secretary Frederick Goh,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: may we now recognize the Chairman of the Committee on Finance,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: no other than our distinguished Deputy,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Senior Deputy Majority Floor Leader and Chairman of the Committee,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And lastly, Majority Leader, just to also explain to the Minority Leader,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: we hope to finish it by Friday.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But, sana matapos po natin ng Friday.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero kung hindi po natin matatapos,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: we're also going to tackle this December 1 and December 2.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, yun naman po ang target.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I also consulted with our Chairman of the Finance Committee

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: at sabi niya, kakayanin naman by Friday.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero baka hindi na tayo matulog, Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But with that, we recognize the Chairman of the Senate Committee on Finance,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mr. President, dear colleagues, fellow workers in government,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and most importantly, the Filipino people,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I humbly rise to present to you House Bill No. 10858

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: or the proposed 2027 General Appropriations Bill

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: It is both an honor and a great responsibility

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to lead the Senate Committee on Finance

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in the review and review of the bill.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and deliberation of the proposed 2027 General Appropriations Bill.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: This representation would like to express

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: his sincere gratitude to the Senate President,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Wingat Shajan, for his trust and confidence

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: of shepherding this very important piece of legislation.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: It is my sincere hope that our collective efforts

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in refining the proposed 2027 National Budget

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: will not only improve the lives of our people next year,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: but be instrumental in shaping a better future

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: have been nothing short of challenging.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: In the middle of an impeachment trial,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: somehow, someway, we were able to squeeze in our briefings

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in an alleged and already tight schedule,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: not to mention the very tight fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I would like to take this opportunity

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to thank our distinguished Vice Chairpersons

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: the men and women of the Legislative Budget Research

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: who are worked alongside with us,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And not to mention, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: the LBRMO staff even had to bring their computers

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to the borrowed CA office in BGC.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: About 40 of them worked for the rest of the week

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: so that there will be no delays

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and we can finish the budget on time.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa inyong sipag,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Your hard work and dedication have been invaluable

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in bringing us to this stage of the budget process.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: when I took on the role of Chairperson

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I've been very vocal from the beginning.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We do not intend to get caught up too much

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: numerical formulas in the budget process.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Our message has been clear and basic.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yes, we should go back to basics.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Before we focus on complicated matters,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: we should focus on what limited resources

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: we have in ensuring that the basic needs

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: is only one part of the equation.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We also need to restore economic momentum.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We need to accelerate the implementation

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and lay down the foundation for long-term growth.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We cannot sustain delivering basic services

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And no one will appreciate economic growth

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: if it will not translate to better basic services.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: is the direction we want to pursue

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: for economic recovery and nation building.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: nanindigan po ako na dapat mumuhunan

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: itinataguin ko po ang pagtutuon na padsin

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: sa kalusugan ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at proyekto ng Department of Health

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: pati na rin ang attached agencies

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: para po sa preventive health services

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Facilities Enhancement Program, or HFEP, o ang programang may kinalaman sa construction at improvement ng mga ospital,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: pati na rin ang mga medical equipment na para sa diagnostics at treatment ng mga pasyente.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ang gusto nga natin, mas palaksid pa ang kakayahan ng mga provincial at ilang locally funded hospitals.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Magiging maayos ang healthcare service delivery network at hindi na kinakailangan ng ating mga kababayan na lumos pa ng Maynila upang magpagamot.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Makatutulong ito para ma-decongest ang ating mga APEX hospitals, hitting two birds with one stone, ika nga.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ngunit hindi po sapat na paramihin lamang ang ating mga pampublikong ospital o pagandahin ang kanilang mga pasilidad.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kailangan din natin tiyakin na may sapat na pondo ang Peel Health,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: upang mas marami Pilipino ang makinabang sa mas malawak na health benefits.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya naman, dinagdagan po ng inyong committee and finance ng 19.8 billion ang pondo ng Peel Health

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: upang maibigay ng buo ang earmarked funds mula sa syntax collections para sa 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Dahil dito ay aabot na sa 94.2 billion ang subsidiya ng Peel Health para sa indirect contributors

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at sa pagpapaganda at pagpapalawak ng kaibigan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Gusto ko sana, gusto sana natin na mapataas ang pondo para sa Peel Health hanggang 100 billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ngunit naintindihan natin na limited ang ating fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ayon sa Peel Health, target nila mapababa ang out-of-pocket health expenses ng ating makababayan

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ito pong dahilan kung bakit mahalagang maibigay natin sa Peel Health ang buong pondong nakalaan dito mula sa syntaxes.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa ganitong paraan, mas maraming benepisyo ang may bibigay ng Peel Health

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at mababawasan ang gastos na kailangan hugutin ng ating makababayan mula sa sarili nila ng bulsa kapag sila ay nagkakasakit.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mahalaga rin po ang pagtuunan ng pansin ang mental health na sa pagdaan ng mga taon ay nakita natin na dapat bigyang atensyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: lalo na sa pag-usad ng modernong panahon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaugnay nito, sinigurado po natin na mula sa mental health program ng DOH,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: malinaw na magagamit ang 300 milyon para sa pagbili at paghahatid ng mahalagang gamot,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: alinsunod na rin po mismo sa Mental Health Act.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa ilalim din po ng Senate version ng budget, kapansin-pansin naman po ang pagbabaan ng medical assistance program,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: previously known as the Medical Assistance to Indigent Infant,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Financially Incapacitated Patients, o ang MAIFIP.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ngunit hindi po dapat ikabahalan ang ating makababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Hindi ito nangangahulugan na mababawasan ang tulong para sa mga pasyente.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa halip, malaking bahagi ng pondo ay direktang nating inilaan sa mga ospital

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: upang mas mapalawak at maayos at maipatupad ang Zero Balance Billing Program.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Basic lang po ang gusto natin dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mapawi ang alalahanin ng bawat pasyente,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: hindi na niya dapat isipin kung saan kukuha ng pambayad sa pagpapagamot

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at ang tanging iintindihin na lamang niya ay ang pagpapagaling.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mababawasan po ang pangangailangan pumila at tumapit sa kung saan saang tanggapan

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: para makahingi ng mga guarantee letters na pambayad sa hospital bills.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mr. President, while we take healthcare accessible,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: it is equally important that we ensure that our people are well-nourished.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Having a healthcare system that we can always rely on is good,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: but we believe that prevention is still better than cure.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: A pandemic is similar to a natural disaster that is almost beyond our control.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Though difficult, what we can prevent is hunger and malnutrition.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We must see to it that every Filipino is able to eat every day.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We continue to push for food security.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: For this to come to fruition, we must ensure the productivity of our farmlands for 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The Department of Agriculture and its attached agencies and corporations,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: including irrigation support, will have a combined budget of around P251 billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: This will ensure that our farmers receive the support they need,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: from sowing seeds, fertilization of crops, to harvesting and selling of goods.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Your Committee has also re-aligned more than P4 billion for the National Rice Program to help boost rice production.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And with the continuing threat of drought and El Niño,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: we have provided P1 billion for the DA's Quick Response Fund, or the QRF,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and P250 million for the Agri-Recover Program to help farmers affected by these conditions.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We cannot stop Super El Niño from happening,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: but we can prepare and be ready to respond the moment it makes its presence felt.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mr. President, this is through the efforts of our distinguished Vice-Chair,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: who is very knowledgeable of the needs and challenges of the agricultural sector,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: National Irrigation Administration will receive P47.5 billion in subsidy

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to allow the continued flow of water for farming.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: the amount of water is only one of the many demands of our farmers.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Para sa mga vegetable farmers ng Benguet at Mountain Province,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: bagama't nabibiyayaan ng mga aning gulay,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: inaabutan ng pagkabulok ang mga kalakal dahil sa

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: kawalan ng angkop na lugar upang pag-imbakan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Buong pagmamalaki po nating ibinabalita ang paglalaan natin ng mahigit isang bilyon

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: para sa pagpapatayo ng Benguet Agri-Pinoy Trading Center,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at Cold Storage Facility sa Barlig, Mountain Province.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ito po ay magsisilbing solusyon sa matagal nang problema ng ating mga kababayang vegetable farmers.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Maliban po ito sa 200 million na inilaan pa sa pagpapatayo naman ng cold storage facility sa Oriental Mindoro.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa halip na mabulok at masayang ang ating pinaghirapang ani,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: ito ay maiiimbak nang mas matagal

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: ang ilang produkto ay maaaring tumagal ng hanggang anim na buwan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mabibigyan din nito ang ating mga magsasaka ng pagkakataong maibenta ang kanilang mga produkto sa mas magandang presyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Hindi lamang po ang ating mga magsasaka makikinabang dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: we can help maintain a stable food supply and prevent sudden increases in food prices,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: particularly during calamities and periods of shortage.
